subject: Music Production
subcategory: Iconic Albums and How They Were Made
title: Tony Bennett's Duets Albums
description: A short lesson to help you apply Tony Bennett's Duets Albums.

hook.text: Tony Bennett's career had faded by the 1980s until his son took over as his manager.

buildup.text: Danny Bennett paired his father with modern stars for a series of duets albums.

discovery.text: Pairing Bennett with Lady Gaga, Amy Winehouse, and others introduced him to new generations.

twist.text: Bennett was in his eighties and nineties during these recordings, yet his voice still captivated.

climax.text: The duets strategy proved that smart production pairing can transcend generational boundaries.

punchline.text: A ninety-year-old voice charmed a new generation.

quiz.question: Who managed Tony Bennett's comeback strategy?
